inputs.scope: Development paths 1–120 only; original loader allow_final=False

summary_metadata.median_method: numpy.median; mean of the two middle values for even sample sizes
summary_metadata.cvar90_definition: average of the worst 10% probability mass, including fractional boundary atoms
summary_metadata.risk_event: MDD - L > 1e-12; smaller differences treated as numerical equality

protocol.status: Declared before computing any market-outcome menus using this evidence screen; the original empirical screen remains the primary developmental reference.
protocol.scope: Secondary conservative simultaneous-bound diagnostic, proposed after V1 and exploratory development exposure. It is not a new blind-final evaluation or real-market certificate.
assumptions: Whole 30-year paths are iid from one common synthetic distribution; the statement gives independence but does not explicitly establish identical distribution.

The policy/event family is fixed: 232 long-only 5pp/exact-thirds static annual targets, contest cost .0025, the five supplied H,L pairs. No forecast or adaptive-target fitting occurs inside a candidate.
protocol.bound: U_wj = Beta inverse survival(delta/1160;k_wj+1,n-k_wj) for k<n; U=1 at k=n. P(all fixed risks p_wj<=U_wj)>=1-delta by union bound.
protocol.selection: For each requested alpha, require U_wj<=alpha, then use the same predeclared common-menu coverage/minimax-regret/mean-regret rule. Because n and confidence allocation are shared, this is equivalent to a fixed maximum exceedance count computed mathematically before market fitting.
protocol.multiplicity: No extra factor for menus or alpha/floor cases when these reuse the same fixed p_wj bounds. Additional cost rates, fine-grid weights, horizons/L events, forecasts or dynamic rules are outside the 1160-event guarantee.
protocol.insufficient_evidence: If even k=0 has U>alpha, report that the sample cannot support that budget under this evidence standard; do not conclude that safe portfolios do not exist.
protocol.growth_severity: The joint bound covers individual product-client exceedance probabilities, not growth, regret, CVaR, all-client simultaneous non-loss, or model/DGP validity.
protocol.folds: Apply the same specified selection procedure to each 96-path training fold, evaluate frozen assignments on 24 test paths. OOF remains a mixed-policy dependent internal diagnostic; no joint confidence claim across folds. A joint assertion across all five training subsets would require additional multiplicity accounting.
protocol.bootstrap: Not used as extra independent evidence. If later used for configuration stability, duplicate paths do not create a new certificate.
protocol.reuse_history: The finite-family theorem permits data-dependent choices inside the fixed family. The family and iid assumptions must be stated, and its retrospective proposal disclosed. It cannot be extended to the former learned forecast/dynamic family merely by counting targets.

scope: Secondary conservative static diagnostic; original empirical research remains primary; retrospectively proposed after exploratory exposure
bound_reuse: 1160 fixed product-client event bounds reused for nine alpha/reserve cases, without an extra case/menu multiplicity factor
fold_scope: Separate training-sample bounds only; no confidence assertion jointly covering all folds and no pooled OOF certificate
referrals: Retained in all coverage denominators; investment outcomes null, without invented adviser or fallback performance
bootstrap: Not used for certification or as additional independent evidence
